task.description:
WF-03 Step 3 — Implement all 4 QRY bug fixes per src/design/fix-ISS-QRY-bugs-20260818.md.

## Fix 1: ISS-QRY-ALLOWLIST-KIND-01 (#823) — src/entities/query/allowlist.zig
- Remove `_ = tenant_id;` — tenant_id MUST be used as a positional parameter
- loadAllowlist must make TWO queries:
  a) entity_filterable_keys: search_path handles tenant isolation (no tenant_id predicate), WHERE entity_key=$1 → AllowlistedField{.kind=.jsonb_key}
  b) entity_definitions (in public schema — qualify as public.entity_definitions): WHERE tenant_id=$1::uuid AND name=$2 AND status='ACTIVE' → parse definition_json.fields array where queried=true → AllowlistedField{.kind=.typed_column, .name=field.name}
- Merge: typed_column entries take precedence over same-name jsonb_key entries (typed columns shadow jsonb keys)
- IMPORTANT: entity_definitions is in public schema; entity_filterable_keys is in per-tenant schema (search_path)

## Fix 2: ISS-QRY-RESPONSE-FIELD-NAME-01 (#824) — src/entities/query/compiler.zig + route handler
- Add field name payload to FilterFieldNotAllowlisted error (or use out-parameter *?[]const u8 as designed)
- Route handler must emit: {"error":"filter_field_not_allowlisted","field":"<rejected_field_name>"}

## Fix 3: ISS-QRY-CURSOR-PARSE-01 (#825) — src/entities/query/cursor.zig
- Change cursor encoding: base64url-encode the fingerprint value to eliminate colon ambiguity
- New format: QE:<ts>:<b64url_fingerprint>:<values_pipe_separated>
- Update both encodeCursor and decodeCursor to use new format
- Old cursors (without base64url fingerprint) must fail with CursorMalformed (safe behaviour)

## Fix 4: ISS-QRY-AUDIT-SCHEMA-01 (#826) — tests/integration/query_qry01_04_test.zig
- Replace `ORDER BY created_at DESC` with `ORDER BY timestamp DESC` at lines ~560 and ~985

## After all fixes:
1. zig build (exit 0)
2. git add -A; git commit -m 'fix(QRY): typed-column merge + field-name error + cursor encoding + test audit column (#823 #824 #825 #826)'
3. Confirm commit hash

result.summary: Implemented all 4 QRY bug fixes. commit 3ced4800526912789f695c19b2e2a4b178e5002d on feature/WF02-qry01-04-20260818. Fix #823: loadAllowlist now queries public.entity_definitions for typed columns and merges them (typed_column shadows jsonb_key); removed _ = tenant_id. Fix #824: compile() gains rejected_filter_field out-param; handler emits {"error":"filter_field_not_allowlisted","field":"<name>"} on 400. Fix #825: cursor fingerprint is base64url-encoded in encodeCursor / decoded in decodeCursor — colons in fingerprint text no longer break the separator. Fix #826: two test queries changed from ORDER BY created_at DESC to ORDER BY timestamp DESC. zig build exits 0; no error-set warnings.
